title: Internship in Reliability Testing for SiC-based Power Semiconductors

titleByLocale.it: Tirocinio in test di affidabilità per semiconduttori di potenza basati su SiC
titleByLocale.en: Internship in Reliability Testing for SiC-based Power Semiconductors
titleByLocale.de: Internship in Reliability Testing for SiC-based Power Semiconductors
titleByLocale.fr: Internship in Reliability Testing for SiC-based Power Semiconductors

descriptionByLocale.it:
The opportunity Join our Semiconductor Packaging and Reliability Engineering research team and contribute to next‑generation power electronics. You will work on silicon carbide semiconductor reliability in a dynamic research environment. The role focuses on developing and improving innovative testing solutions for power devices. You collaborate closely with experts and gain insights into real research challenges. You will grow by combining experimental work with data analysis and system development. This position offers hands‑on access to advanced laboratories and close cooperation with industry and academia. How you'll make an impact Conduct measurement campaigns and analyze reliability data of SiC devices Develop and improve test setups for dynamic reliability testing Design solutions for advanced sensing and automated data collection Optimize power converter systems for long-term testing Upgrade measurement electronics and data acquisition systems Support integration of monitoring systems for device aging Document and communicate results within research and business teams Your background Currently enrolled in a Master's program in physics, electr onics engineering , materials engineering or a related discipline (official enrolment is essential) Familiar with electrical measurements setup and with the design and construction of electronics systems . Previous experience with semiconductor physics and\/or power devices is a strong plus Experience with LabView programming, and knowledge of programming languages ( e . g. Python, C , Matlab ) Fluency in written and spoken English Good communication and technical writing skills Creative and able to work autonomously More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.
